observations: Confirmed Item deletion selects Zulu details automatically on the regular layout, preserving the chosen descending sort.
Inbox retains cumulative completion/archive visibility and restores Todo source state after final-membership removal and relaunch.
Lord Howe requires explicit occurrence and retains GMT+11 or GMT+10:30 after relaunch, with its row reflecting device display time.
Repeated End rejects EDT 01:15 after EDT 01:45, accepts EST 01:15, and retains the original saved span after canceling a nonexistent March End.
Itinerary zone-only editing retains the source and booked instant; converted all-day forms reopen with inclusive dates.
Schedule removal explains its scope and leaves the Itinerary and its other appointment intact after relaunch.

The Itinerary content toolbar has a larger gap below the floating tabs than the Item catalog in these portrait captures; duplicate titles, technical clock footer and truncated Itinerary title remain polish work.
limits: Represented ordinary-size iPad workflows only; no phone Itinerary caller, Mac, physical, full accessibility or whole-app acceptance is inferred.
